Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Head of Risk / Internal Audit to lead the company&rsquo;s enterprise risk management, internal audit, and internal control functions.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating key credit, operational, financial, compliance, and other business risks.
	The role will ensure that appropriate internal controls are established and effectively implemented in line with regulatory requirements, prudential guidelines, and industry best practices.
	The successful candidate will also review credit requests, monitor loan and delinquency portfolios, conduct internal audits, identify control weaknesses, prepare periodic risk and audit reports for Management and the Board, and provide recommendations to strengthen the company&rsquo;s risk management framework and overall governance.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop, implement, and maintain an effective enterprise risk management framework.
	Identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate credit, operational, financial, liquidity, compliance, and other business risks.
	Lead the internal audit function and conduct periodic reviews of business processes and controls.
	Evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls and recommend corrective actions where necessary.
	Review credit requests and assess associated credit risks in line with approved policies.
	Monitor loan portfolios, delinquency levels, and emerging credit risks.
	Investigate control exceptions, operational losses, and potential risk exposures.
	Ensure compliance with applicable microfinance regulations, prudential guidelines, and internal policies.
	Develop and maintain appropriate risk registers and monitoring tools.
	Prepare periodic risk, internal audit, and compliance reports for Management and the Board.
	Provide strategic recommendations to strengthen risk management, internal controls, and decision-making.
	Promote a strong risk and compliance culture across the organization.
	Follow up on audit findings and ensure implementation of agreed corrective actions.
	Keep Management informed of emerging risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.

	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Banking, or a related discipline.
	8&ndash;10 years of relevant experience in risk management, internal audit, or controls, preferably within a microfinance bank or financial institution.
	Professional certification such as ICAN or ACCA is mandatory.
	MBA or Master&rsquo;s degree in a relevant discipline will be an added advantage.
	Strong knowledge of enterprise risk management, credit risk, operational risk, internal controls, and audit principles.
	Good understanding of microfinance regulations, prudential guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
	Strong knowledge of credit assessment and loan portfolio monitoring.
	Excellent analytical, investigative, reporting, and decision-making skills.
	Strong leadership and communication skills.
	High level of integrity, independence, confidentiality, and attention to detail.

Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: recruitment@manpawabusinesssupport.com using &ldquo;Head of Risk / Internal Audit&rdquo; as the subject of the email.

Airport Manager Job at Etihad Airways




        
    

        
        Etihad Airways, the national airline of the UAE, was formed in 2003 to bring “Abu Dhabi to the World”. Over the years, we have grown into Etihad Aviation Group, a diversified global aviation and travel company, which is one of the world’s most acclaimed industry brands.

Our airline flies to over 84 destinations with a fleet of over 100 Airbus and Boeing aircraft, serving 18.6 million passengers a year and carrying 682,000 tonnes of cargo in 2018.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Airport Manager 

Job Location: Lagos

Job Description
     

            
    




	Let your career take off with the World’s Leading Airline, Etihad Airways. Work in the forefront of the airline and travel industry, with the airline that has reimagined the flying experience through its pioneering products and services.
	As an Airport Manager, you will lead, plan and direct the airport operation, overseeing team and service provider performance. Ensure financial, customer service, quality, safety and security objectives are delivered in accordance with all applicable safety, security, regulatory and company requirements and standards. Lead and manage all elements of operations while on duty.


Accountabilities


	Direct and oversee all passenger and aircraft handling operations on a management and shift basis, ensuring adherence to all arrival/departure checklists, brand requirements, company policy/procedures and regulatory requirements
	Actively participate in the daily operation, working shifts including weekends and/or public holidays, where required, to deliver the local operation
	Responsible for the effective management of safety and security outcomes through safety and security promotion, hazard identification and risk assessment, safety, security and compliance monitoring and reporting
	Ensure all flight editing and special guest requirements are met, including but not limited to assessment, planning and coordination of VIP/MAAS, PRM and special category guests
	Deliver, maintain and rehearse station emergency response plan, disruption planning, diversion/delay handling and business continuity plans
	Accountable for on time performance including management, mitigation, accurate reporting and follow-up of delays
	Accountable for airport ancillary sales performance, promotion, coordination and process compliance monitoring
	Accountable for promotion, delivery, monitoring and reporting on customer service-related standards, including performance against associated KPIs
	Perform the role of Local Security Contact Officer


Qualifications


	Degree level education desirable (A-level or baccalaureate equivalent) or relevant industry experience, with a demonstrable knowledge of leadership, project management and business solutions skills
	7-9 years of relevant experience in a leadership or senior management capacity with exposure to global business best practice
	Previous exposure to highly pressured and multicultural environment in a management/supervisory role within a shift environment required
	Proven ability to lead and drive results and communicate internally and externally on a large scale across multiple channels
	Previous regional or international exposure highly advantageous.
